lines.1: The moment she grabbed my arm, she whipped her legs around it.
lines.3: She took me straight to the floor.
lines.4: Then Otome climbed on top of me.
lines.5: 「It'll be rough, but I'll punish you and straighten out your body at the same time.」
lines.7: 「It's a massage to work out your fatigue.」
lines.9: 「It won't leave a mark. Do not worry.」
lines.11: Ahh, come to think of it--
lines.12: Life used to be pretty peaceful.
lines.13: But ever since she moved in, everything had gotten strange.
lines.14: Or maybe just a whole lot noisier...
lines.15: Otome sat on top of me and did whatever she pleased.
lines.16: I was well and truly under her heel.
lines.17: B-but why was I taking damage here of all places?
